facts.fact: Al3omk reports the Interior Minister's written answer that GIR-CT, adopted by joint circulars of 2020 on its use and generalisation, lets local-government revenue offices extract receipts and payment permits electronically on collecting revenue.

Al3omk reports the Interior Minister saying an electronic platform for declaring and paying local-government taxes has been prepared and activated, under decree 2.22.176 of 29 March 2022 and joint order 733.22.
facts.system: Local taxes electronic declaration and payment platform

MAR.note: The platform is for local-government taxes, not the tax authority's own system.
